kevalānandasarasvatī
vijayā daśamī guruvāsaraḥ śakaḥ 1876.
prakāśakasya nivedanam
asmadgurucaraṇaiḥ kevalānandasarasvatībhiḥ saṃpāditasyāsya pūrvamīmāṃsākoṣasya tṛtīyabhāgena prakārayamānena gīrvāṇavāṇīpraṇayināṃ tattvadarśanaprāṇānāṃ ṣaṭkarmmā'nvīkṣikyāṃ kṛtapariśramāṇāṃ viśeṣataḥ mīmāṃsātarkalāghave prāṇihitamanasāṃ pariṇataprajñānāṃ cetāṃsi samullāsamabhaveyurityā- śasmahe |
gurucaraṇānāṃ khalu valīpalitavatāmāyuṣaḥ aṣṭasaptatitamāṃ śaradaṃ praviṣṭhānāmapi yogā- nuṣṭhānalabdhasamādhivaibhavena smṛtiḥ dhiṣaṇā śarīrasaṃpattiśca saṃpratyapi prabhāvatyeva gambhīrasya mīmāṃsārṇavasya talabhavagāhitum |
etasmādeva hetoḥ anumaṃsyāmahe yat praprakāśayipitānāṃ samagrāṇāmtāṃ bhāgānāṃ prakāśanaṃ gurucaraṇānāṃ samakṣameva nirvartayituṃ śakyāmahaḥ iti |
asya bhāgasya mudraṇārthaṃ muṃbaīvidyāpīṭhena pañca śatāni rūpyakāṇi dattvā vayamupakṛtā iti tasyānugrahaṃ nitarāmabhinandāmaḥ |
vijayā daśamī
lakṣmaṇaśāstrī jośī, tarkatīrtha: adhyakṣa: prājñapāṭhaśālā maṇḍalasya mukhyasaṃpādakaśca dharmakośasya

prastāvaḥ
mīmāṃsākoṣasyāyaṃ tṛtīyo bhāgaḥ prakāśyate |
tasyādau ‘upāṃśuyāje dhrauvājyasya vidhānam’ ityadhikaraṇaṃ kramaprāptam |
ante ca ‘jyotiṣṭome tulyānyaviśiṣṭaṃ hi kāraṇam’ iti laghusiddhāntaḥ |
mīmāṃsākoṣo'yaṃ na śabdakoṣo na vā vākyakoṣaḥ; kintu viṣayakoṣo'yam |
mīmāṃsā- śāstrasya ākaragrantheṣu prakaraṇagrantheṣu ca ye pratipāditā viṣayāḥ, teṣāṃ varṇakrameṇātra racanā kṛtā bhavati |
varṇakrameṇa racanā ca sthūladṛṣṭyā ca sūkṣmadṛṣṭyā ceti dvedhā saṃbhavati |
tatrādyā vācakānāṃ viṣayopalambhāya sujñeyā bhavati, dvitīyā tu kiñcidiva kliṣṭā |
tatra prathame dvitīye ca bhāge sthūladṛṣṭiva svīkṛta''sīt |
tṛtīyabhāge'smin ādau saiva svīkṛtā |
ante tu kiyaticit pravibhāge dvitīyā dṛṣṭiḥ svīkṛtā |
ita uttaraṃ ca dvitīyaiva svīkriyate śuddhatvāt tasyāḥ |
tacca spaṣṭārthaṃ kiñcidivādāhriyate— ‘jaimineḥ paratantrāpatteḥ’ ityādiko binduḥ, ‘jaimineḥ paratantrāpatteḥ’ ityaparo binduḥ |
atrobhayatrāpi ‘jaimineḥ parata’ ityakṣarāṇi samānānyeveti nātra vicāryam, agre tu ‘trāpa’ ityekatra ‘ntratāpa’ ityaparatra |
evaṃ sati anayoḥ kramaścintanīyaḥ |
tatra ‘tra’ iti hrasvamakṣaram, ‘trā’ iti ca dīrgham |
hrasvaṃ pūrvaṃ dīrghamuttaram iti ca sthūlaḥ kramaḥ |
tathā ca ‘tantrāpatteḥ’ iti binduḥ pūrvaṃ niveśanīyaḥ ‘tantrāpatteḥ’ iti tu paścāt iti sugamaḥ panthāḥ |
sūkṣmadṛṣṭyā tu vicāre ‘tantrāpatteḥ’ ‘tantra+āpatteḥ’ iti śabdabhedaḥ, dvitīye tu ‘tantra+tva+āpatteḥ’ iti śabdabhedaḥ |
sati caivaṃ ‘tantrāpatteḥ’ iti pūrvaṃ niveśyam ‘tantratvāpatteḥ’ iti paścāt iti matirasamākam |
yathā vā ‘avaghātānvāyaḥ’ iti ‘avaghātādidharmāḥ’ iti ca dvau bindū |
atra ‘avaghā’ itya- kṣarāṇi samānānyeva |
tataḥ paraṃ ta-hrasvaḥ, tā-dīrghaḥ iti sthūladṛṣṭyā ādau ‘avaghātānvāyaḥ’ iti binduṃ niveśya parastāt ‘avaghātādidharmāḥ’ iti bindurniveśanīyaḥ iti sthūlā paddhatiḥ |
parantu ‘avaghāta-ādi’ iti padabhedāt akārasya ca nakārāt prācīnatvāt ādau ‘avaghātādi- dharmāḥ’ iti bindurniveśyaḥ, tataḥ param ‘avaghātānvāyaḥ’ iti |
iti dik |
mīmāṃsākoṣo'yaṃ yadyapi viṣayakoṣaḥ, tathāpi śatasahasrādisaṃkhyātatvād bhūyiṣṭhānāṃ viṣayāṇāṃ parasparasaṃbaddhatvāt yathāyathaṃ varṇakrameṇaiva te niveśanīyā iti durūhavo varṇakramaḥ, iti varṇakramaṃ svīkṛtyaiva racanā kartavyā |
tatra rītidvayitve idānīmevoktā dvitīyā rītireva tṛtīyabhāgānte svīkṛtā, caturthādibhāgeṣu ca saiva svīkariṣyate śuddhatvāt ityuktameva |
vācakānāṃ tu atra kiñcit skhalitamiva syāt tathāpi śuddhatvapakṣapātena kiñcit kaṣṭaṃ svīkariṣyanti sahṛdayā iti āśāmahe |
adhikāraṇādisaṃkhyā—tṛtīye asmin bhāge bhāṣyādhikaraṇāni 164, saṃkarṣādhikaraṇāni 21, kevalānandīvṛttyadhikaraṇāni 126, tautātikādhikaraṇāni 5, nyāyā: 309, laghu- siddhāntākṣa 310 |

adhikaraṇaśīrṣakāṇi
mīmāṃsākoṣe tāvat adhikaraṇaśīrṣakāṇi varṇakrameṇa niveśitānyatra, atra tu pāṭhakrameṇeti viśeṣaḥ |
yānyeva tu tatra varṇakrameṇa, tānyevātra pāṭhakrameṇa |
itthamubhayathā niveśe ca vācakānāṃ bhūyānupakāraḥ syāditi kalpanā- smākam |
śīrṣakeṣu ca kānicit pāribhāṣikāni syuḥ, kānicinya adhikaraṇārthabodhakāni syuḥ |
ubhayānyapi yadyapi adhikaraṇārthabodhakānyeva tathāpi pāribhāṣikeṣu kleśena arthabodhaḥ, itareṣu tu kleśābhāva iti viśeṣaḥ |
nanu tarhi pāribhāṣikāṇi naivātra niveśitavyāni, sayam |
tathāpi mīmāṃsāyāmeva ākaragrantheṣu tatratatra pāribhāṣikāṇyeva adhikaraṇanāmāni uddiśyante, dharma- śāstradiṣu ca pāribhāṣikaireva vyavahāraḥ |
tasmāt pāri- bhāṣikāṇi avaśyaṃ niveśitavyāni |
keṣāṃcidadhikaraṇānāṃ ca pāribhāṣikaṃ nāma nopalabhyate, tatra apāribhāṣikameva niveśanāīmiti ubhayathā samāveśaḥ |
atra ca tattadadhyāyattatpādaviṣayapradarśanam adhyāya- pādasaṃgatipradarśanaṃ ca kariṣyate |
adhikaraṇasaṃgatipradarśanaṃ ca koṣe eva bhaviṣyati |

tatra antimamadhyāyacatuṣṭayaṃ brahmāmīmāṃsā nāma śāstrāntara- miti bhagavatpūjyapādasiddhāntaḥ |
ata eva saṃkarṣa- kāṇḍānte 'vidyate'nyakālatvād yathā yājyāsaṃpreṣo yathā yājyāsaṃpreṣaḥ' iti dviruktiḥ |
naitādṛśī ca padādi- dviruktiḥ : ṣoḍaśalakṣaṇyām |
brahmāmīmāṃsāyāṃ tu prathama- dvitīyatṛtīyeṣu adhyāyasamāptiyotakaḥ padābhyāsaḥ, caturthe ca śāstrasamāptiyotakaḥ sūtranyāsaḥ prasiddhaḥ |
asmā-

uttare catvāro'dhyāyāḥ saṃkarṣakāṇḍaṃ saṃkarṣaṇakāṇḍaṃ vā |

akārāyanukrameṇādhikaraṇaśīrṣakāṇi
[itaḥ paraṃ dvādaśalakṣaṇīsthāni adhikaraṇaśīrṣakāṇi saṃkarṣakāṇḍacaturlakṣaṇīlakṣaṇīsthāni adhikaraṇaśīrṣakāṇi ca ekīkṛtya varṇakrameṇa niveśyante |
tatra pūrvaṃ pāṭhakramopamyantāni śīrṣakāṇyeva santi, parantu tatratyapradhānaśabdān prāthamyena upanyasya tadanusāreṇa śeṣapadāni yathāyathaṃ viparīvarya pūrvasaṃsthāpekṣayā dviguṇena vardhayitvā niveśyante, na kevalaṃ prācīnānāmeva yathāllikhitarūpeṇaiveti dhyeyam |
evaṃ sati nānārītyā yathecchaṃ adhikaraṇalābhaḥ syāt |
saṃkarṣakāṇḍasya adhyāyacatuṣṭayaṃ yadyapi vastutaḥ 13-16 ityevāṅkāḥ pradarśanīyāḥ, tathāpi assāmiḥ 1-2-3-4 ityukteraiva adhyāyanirdeśaḥ kṛtaḥ |
yatra 'saṃkarṣa.' iti aṅkādau niveśaḥ tat śīrṣakaṃ saṃkarṣakāṇḍastham, tatra ca adhyāyapādādhikaraṇaṅkā niveśitāḥ |
'saṃkarṣa' itipadarahita- kevalāṅkaniveśe tu dvādaśalakṣaṇīsthaṃ śīrṣakaṃ jñeyam |
tatra ca adhyāyapādādhikaraṇaṅkātrayameva nirdiṣṭaṃ na sūtrāṅkā niveśitāḥ |
atrayavarṇakrame tu tṛtīyabhāgaprastāve pradarśitadvitīyaye prathamameva saralavarṇakramarūpeva svīkṛtā, na tu dvitīyā śākhīya rītirityavekṣyam |

ke. ubhayasāmni naimittikaṃ vikalpena samatvāt syāt |

'audumbaro yupo bhavati, ūrdhvā udumbaraḥ, ūrka paśāvaḥ, ūrjaivāsmā ūrjaṃ paśūnāpnoti, ūrjau'va- dadhai' iti |
kimasya vidhiḥ kāryam, uttasyāpi stuti- riti |

phalaṃ hyavagamyate |

kutaḥ saṃśayaḥ ? (saṃdehamasamartha caturthā pūrva- pakṣaṃ saṃbhāvayati-) pūrvatra hi svārthānupayogitvena dūra- lakṣitastutigrahaṇam aṅgīkṛtam |
tatstambhe tu stutirapi anarthakatvā apyate |
vidhivaśca na kathaṃ cana anya- syāt |
prarocanā punaḥ kathañcit vidhudeśādapi upapadyate ityuktaṃ purastāt |
api ca pradhānaṃ vidhiḥ, aṅgaṃ stutiḥ |
tatra pradhānaviśeṣaṇatvenaḥ tadvāmitameva yuktam |
samāpte ca vidhyudeśe arthavādaḥ pravartate |
tattha- kramāvadhyāyemeva tu bhāvanāṃśāḥ saṃnipatanti |
viśeṣeṇa tu phalaṃ prādhyamaprādhānyābhyām ityādi manvānaḥ apūrvatvāt iti vadati, tatpekṣayā ca stutimātram anarthakaṃ manyate |
nanu ca evaṃjātīyakaḥ 'phalavidhiḥ, uta arthavādaḥ' iti vicāraḥ caturthe'pi 'dravyasaṃskārakarmasu' (4|1|1) iti bhaviṣyati, ato neha prastottamya |
tatra cet cittam āhuḥ, anena gatārthatvāt tatraiva paryanuyogo yujyate, na tu idaṃ punaruktamiti (idaṃ samādhānaṃ dūṣayati -) satyamevam, yadi tu tatkālapratīkṣāṃ kaścit parihārā- ntaraṃ labhyate |
ataḥ tatra anvicchema, atha punaḥ ihaiva śakyate vaktum, tathā sati idānīmapi ucyamāne mando doṣa iti |
(apīnaruktye parihāryaṃ caturaḥ prakārānupamyasya dūṣayati -) tatrapare vadanti, tena phalavidhivinirā- karaṇamātram, iha tu arthavattvāya |
arthavādaḥ syāt iti tatra vakṣyati, tat vidhivinirākaraṇamātrameva draṣṭavyam |
tadayuktam |
yataḥ tena phalavidhitvāt pracyavitānām
ānarthakyaprasaktau pūrvādhikaraṇenaiva ( 1|2|12 ) stutya- thetā sādhitā, tathā ca darśitam 'śobhate'sya mukham' ityādiṣu ( 1|2|15 ) |
kecit punaḥ āhuḥ- yuktam 'vāyurvai kṣepiṣṭhā' ityādīnāṃ stutim, 'ūrjau- 'vadadhai' iti punaḥ yathā phalavidhitvāt prayujyante, tathaiva visaṃvādena stutivādāpi, iti kāmaṃ vidhirbhavatu, yena kālāntaramāvitvena kathañcit visaṃvādo nivartate ityārambhaḥ (asyādhikaraṇasya) |

'iha aśeṣadravyaguṇakriyādi- vidhirūpāḥ, tatra phalavidhirūpā eva udāharaṇam' ityapare |
tathā ca 'vidhiśrānarthakaḥ ka cit' ( 1| 2|23 ), 'prakaraṇe ca saṃbhavanam' (24) iti ca, 'appuyonirvā aśvaḥ, ambhujo vetasaḥ' 'yo vidagdhaḥ' iti codāhiyate |
anyathā phalavidhiśramopanyāse tat asaṃddhameva syāt |
(nirasyati-) ihāpi tasya tāvat viśeṣaviṣayatvāt idamagatārthaṃ bhavet, anena tu sāmānyataḥ sarvaviṣayavivecanā tat punaruktameva |

atra vadāmaḥ; kim adhikaraṇadvayam avaśyakartavyam, yena evamudāharaṇavyavasthā āśrīyate |
nahi udāharaṇabhedāt adhikaraṇaṃ bhidyate, mā bhūt yathā- vyavasthite'pi lādidaudumbaratvabhedāt apaunaruktyam |
nyāyaviṣayatvena tu adhikaraṇatāṃ tadeva eva apauna- ruktye hetuḥ |

na ca tatra caitra- vṛttiḥ pākaḥ |
abhāvapratiyogī iti, bhūtalabhṛṣṭaniṣṭhā sattā abhāvapratiyoginī ityevaṃ śābdabodhāṅgīkārāt nānyāptiḥ, 'hade vahniāsti' ityādī pratiyogitā'- vacchedakāvacchinnasyapratiyoginaḥ aprasiddhā avyāpyā- patteḥ |

aya tatra viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyayoḥ ubhayorbhavanāśrayatvam, tadā 'cakre ghaṭo bhavati' ityādī kasyāpi tadāpattiḥ |
atha yadyātvarthāśrayatvena ca vivakṣitaḥ, sa tatkartā ityu- cyate, cakre ca vivakṣā'bhāvāt nātiprasaṅgaḥ, tadā 'paṭo ghaṭo na' ityādī anyonyābhāvapratiyogini ghaṭādau dhātvarthāśrayatvābhāvāt anyāptiḥ |

tathāpi ubhayatrāpi tiṅapātta- sahasravyāptyapatteḥ |
'ghaṭo na paṭo' itiprayogānapatteḥ |
etena 'ghaṭo na paṭaḥ' ityatra ghaṭapadaṃ ghaṭapratiyogikānyo- nyābhāvalakṣakam, nañ ca tātparyagrāhakam, anyasya ubhayopi 'śuklo ghaṭaḥ', 'aghaṭaḥ paṭaḥ' itivat pārśvikāmedasaṃbandhamādāya viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvena vā adhyāhṛtakriyāyām, ityapāstam |

api ca naiva kartrā pratyayārthe: karma vā ityācāryā āhu:|
nanu kartari karmaṇi ca lakāra: śrūyate|
nāsau kartari karmaṇi vā śrūyate, kintu ekasmin ekavacanam, dvayo- rdvivacanam, bahuṣu bahuvacanam, iti tatra aparaṃ vacanam|
tatra evamabhisambandha: kriyate ekasmin kartari, dvayo: kartro:, bahuṣu kartṛṣu iti|
evaṃ karmaṇi eka- sminniti|
kathaṃ tarhi ? kartari ekasmin ekavacanaṃ kartṛrekatve ityartha:|
evaṃ dvitve bahutve, karmaṇi ca|

ucyate|
arthaprāptā hi karmādaya:; tena bhavanti śabdasāmidheyabhūtā:; na tu ekatvādaya: arthāta prāpnuvanti, tena te śabdārthabhūtā:|

yā tu tebhya: pratīti:; sā saṃyogā ntarato bhavet |
' sarvatraiva tāvat śabdāducca- ritāt aneko'rtho gamyate|
na ca tāvatā sarva: evā- bhidheyo bhavati, tadbhāvabhāvitattvānupapattivattvāt vācakaśakti kalpyanāyā:|

kva cāsau adṛṣṭā satī kalpyate ? yatra tatkalpanāntareṇa pratītiprayogau nāvakalpete|
yatra tu anyaviṣayayaiva śakyā akalpi- tayā tayā anyatrāpi tau sidhyata:, tatrāpulabdhyā śakya- bhāva: pratīyate yathā ākṛtiśabdānāṃ vyaktau, siṃhādi- śabdānāṃ ca mānavakādau|
tadiha pañcāśadiśabdāccaraṇāt iyanto'rthā gamyante bhāvanā-dhātvartha-kartṛ-tatsakhyā- puruṣa-upagraha-kālaviśeṣā:|
(puruṣa: prathamamadhyamo-
ttamarūpa:, upagraha: parasmaipadātmanedarūpa:)|
teṣāṃ tu ka: śabda:, ko'rthāt iti vibhāgo na jñāyate|

na ca tayā kālādaya: pratipādyante, kālāntarasaṃkhyā'ntaratvātpuruṣopagrahāntareṣvapi dṛṣṭa- tvāt|
evaṃ kālasaṃkhyā''dīnāṃ parasparavyabhicārādeva agamyakatvaṃ gamyam|
yādṛśaśca guṇabhūta: kartā atrā- vagamyate, na tādṛśena vinā bhāvanā upapadyate ityārthā- patyā anumānena vā śaktā gamayitum|
kārakāntare'pi saṃbandhena vyabhicārāt aśakteti cenna, anyasaṃbandhamātrā- tmakavyabhicārānabhyupagamāt|
dvidhā hi eka: saṃbandha anekena saṃbadhyate, kaścit saṃbandhanyataraṃ parityajan, kaścit pūrvāparityāgena|
tatra ya: parityajya anyatrānyatra vartate, sa vyabhicārādagamako bhavati yathā ūrdhvaṃ sthāṇupuruṣayo:|
na ca tatra anyasaṃbandha: kathaṃ vyabhi- cārasya|
kiṃ tarhi ? tena vinā'pi pravṛtti:|
yastu anyatrāpi vartamāna: pūrvāvagatasaṃbandhaparyavasānenaiva vartate yathā śiśapālatvaṃ vṛkṣatvapārthivatvavadityeṣu, na tasya anaukāntikatvam, sarveṣu pralāyanaśaktyavighātāt|

na cedaśa vyabhicāritvamucyate, anyatrāpi vṛttau pūrvāparityāgāt|
ata: sarvakārakāṇi asaṃśayaṃ gamyante|

eva ca eṣo'rtha: (bhāvanāyā: kārakāntaravyabhicāra- rūpa: ) saṃkhyāsaṃbandhe (ghaṭanīye) kartu: asādhāraṇatā- siddhayartham|
asitaddhitvāttu karaṇāpekṣaṇāt, calana- patanādiṣu ca ādhāranāśavaṇāt, akarmakeṣu karmā- bhāvāt, āsanasthānavacanādiṣu saṃpradānāpādānātvāt kartaiva sarvabhāvanāsu ekāntasaṃnihita:, iti asādhāraṇatvena tiruvācyayā saṃkhyayā saṃbhanasyate|
kartṛviśiṣṭā ceha saṃkhyā gamyate, na kārakāntaragatā, iti sarveṣāṃ pratyakṣam|
tatra yadi kaścit vadet 'samāne sarvakārakāṇāṃ gamya- mānatve kasmāt kartṛva saṃkhyāsaṃbandha:, na karaṇādibhirapi iti, sa vaktavyo yathaiva bhavata: iti|
sa cet brūyāt 'mama kartā saṃkhyā ca ekena śabdena upāttau parasparaṃ niyabhyete iti, tena anabhidheyebhyo bāhyebhyo niyabhyatā saṃkhyā kartaryaiva vartitavye ' iti|
tatra evaṃ pratyavastheyam, 'atha samāne kārakatve kiṃ kāraṇaṃ bhavata:, kartaivā- bhidhīyate, na kārakāntarāṇi ' iti, tatra avaśyaṃ phalāvagamyā śabdaśaktireva śaraṇaṃ pratipattavyā, yata: tadviṣayā buddhirutpadyate|
sā ca asatpakṣe- 'pi aviśiṣṭā ' yata: kartṛgatāṃ saṃkhyāṃ pratīma: kevalāmata:|
tasmādetāvatī śaktistatkathaṃ kāryāt pratīyate |
' 'samāne bhāvanā kārakopasthāne ka: śaktiniyame hetu: ' iti cet, 'ukte yatsava samāne kārakatve kartṛbhidhāne śaktiniyame hetu: ' iti|

tāmāha |
nanu nāmumeyaṃ karma, kintu rūpidravyasamaveta-cākṣuṣameva, ‘gacchatyayam’ iti pratīteḥ indriyavyāpārāyat-tvāt |
tathā ca tantrāntare sūtram ‘saṃkhyāḥ parimāṇāni pṛthaktvaṃ saṃyogavibhāgī paratvāparatve karma ca rūpidravya-samavāyāccākṣuṣāṇi’ (kaṇādasūtra 4|1|11) iti |
atha saṃyogavibhāgānumitikriyāviṣayo'yaṃ pratyaya iti |
tadanupapannam |
ākāśasya atīndriyatvāt tena saha saṃyogasya vāyuvanaspatiyogavat apratyakṣatvāt liṅga-bhāvāt patatsu patatriṣu ‘patati’ iti buddhineṃ syāt |
ayocyate, vihāyasi vitataistaraṇakiraṇaiḥ saha saṃyoga-vibhāgī pratyakṣī liṅgamiti, tanna |
sāndrāndhakāre niśīthe jhaṭiti taḍiti sphurantyau calatīti pratīteḥ |
api ca saṃyogavibhāgī gamye gantari ca staḥ |
tābhyāṃ cet karma anumeyam, gantarau tadbuddhiḥ gambe'pi syāt |
kiñca kāryavirodhiva karma |
tataśca saṃyogādupaste karmaṇi vartamānāvābhāso na syāt |
kiñca saṃyoga-vibhāgī karma anumāpayitumīśāte |
tasyāpi kādācitka-tvena hetvantarāpekṣatvāt, tadetvabhimatādeva tayorupapatteḥ |
tadetat badhidoṣavilāsamātram |
anumitakriyā-nimittaḥ calatīti pratyayaḥ |
vighuti tu medhāvayava-saṃyogavibhāgaliṅgānumitā calanakriyā iti nānuppattiḥ |
na ca gamye kriyā'numānam |

katham ? aindriyakatva- laiṅgikatvayoḥ kena viśeṣeṇa laiṅgikatvāsvīkāra iti cet, asteva viśeṣaḥ |

ato yatra pratīti- statrendriyasya śaktiriti prativiṣayamindriyasya śakti- kalpanayā laiṅgikatvenāpi upapatteḥ aindriyakatvakalpana- manyāyyam |

ataḥ anumeyaiva kriyā |
kiṃ tarhi kriyā'numāne liṅgam ? vibhāgapūrvakaḥ saṃyogaḥ |
tathāhi, yadyat kadācit tattadāgantukat- jāyamānaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ yathā tantusaṃyogeyaḥ paṭaḥ, ayamapyā- gantukatvānniti |
āgantukaśabdena asamavāyi- kāraṇamucyate |
nanu samatāyena anaikāntikaḥ, tasya samavāyikāraṇasamavāyikāraṇayoramātrāt |

naivam, tasyāpi piṇḍasamavāyikāraṇādinā upapatteḥ |
tathā coktaṃ prakaraṇa- pañjikāyām, 'yatra eva hi piṇḍasyodayaḥ samavāyi- kāraṇāt, tata eva tasya jātisamānāṃ'pi saṃpadyate' iti |
samavāyikāraṇasamavāyikāraṇakṣaṇaṃ ca samavāya- vyatirekaviṣayam, ato nānyaikāntikam |

yat kāryam tat kāraṇamiti vyāptiḥ, na punaryatra kāryaṃ tatra kāraṇamiti |

kriyā'numeyatā 1515 kriyāpratiniyamavidhiḥ
vibhāgat prayatnavadātmanaḥ śarīrasaṃyogādeva vibhāga- saṃyogayorupapattī kimantargūḍhanā karmaṇā ? pratyakṣatve tu yathādarśanaṃ karmāṅgīkāre'pi na doṣaḥ |
naivam, saṃyogo hi svāśraye svāśrayasamavete vā kāryamārabhate iti niyatam |
yathā tantusaṃyoge svāśrayeṣu tantuṣu paṭam, patracāśrayasaṃyoge'pi svāśrayasamavete avayavini mahattvam, tanturīsaṃyogestu svāśraye turyām, svāśraya- samavete ca paṭe paṭuttarīsaṃyogam, ataḥ svāśrayāsvāśra- yayoḥ śarīradeśayorvibhāgasaṃyogau saṃyogahetuko na bhavataḥ |
ata ātmaśarīrasaṃyogāt svāśraye śarīre karmotpadyate, tato vibhāgasaṃyogāviti na karmavicchedaḥ |
nanu yathā svāśraye kāryakarasya saṃyogasya svāśrayasamavete'pi kārya- karatvamahaṅgīkṛtam, tathaiva astrāśraye'pi kāryakaratva- maṅgīkṛtyām, svāśrayasamavete'pi hetvantaraṃ vā kalpyatām, kimarthavaiśasena ? naivam, anvayavyatirekābhyāṃ hi svāśraye svāśrayasamavete ca hetutvam, tatrānyadarśanā- pekṣā anyatarasya nāsti |
ātmaśarīrasaṃyogasya vibhāga- saṃyogahetutve nāstyanvayavyatirekābhyāṃ hetutvam, vyati- rekābhāvāt |
ātmaśarīrasaṃyoge satyeva kāryasyodayāt yadyapi siddho'nvayaḥ, tathāpi ātmaśarīrasaṃyogasya sarvadā satvāt nāsti tadabhāve kāryahāniḥ |
ataśca buddhyādīnāmātmakāraṇatvavat anvayavyatirekāvasitakārya- kāraṇabhāvadṛṣṭāntena tatsamavetakāryatvādiyādihetunā anumānena kāryakāraṇabhāvaḥ, iti prativaktavyam |
ato'- nvayavyatirekāpekṣatvādanumānasya, anvayavyatirekābhyāṃ ca svāśraye svāśrayasamavete vā kāryarambhasya avagata- tvāt, tadanusāreṇānumātavyam, na astrāśraye iti |
svāśrayasvāśrayasamavetedāharaṇayoranyonyāpekṣā nāsti, tuhyapramāṇagamyatvāt, ataḥ saṃyogasya svāśrayasama- vete vā kāryarambhakatvaṃ nāstyeti karmānumeyam |
arthendriyasaṃyogasya ātmani jñānajanakatvāt svāśraye iti niyamo nāstīti cenna, asamavāyikāraṇaprayuktatvāt asya niyamasya |
arthendriyasaṃyogastu nimittakāraṇam |
asamavāyikāraṇasyāpi tatraiva vyabhicāraḥ, veṇudalavibhāga- samavāyikāraṇe khalvibhāgāpatteḥ ekatvena ca khādeḥ
kriyāyāśca deśavibhāgasaṃyogayostatheti cet, evaṃ hi asamavāyikāraṇasaṃyogaprayuktaḥ |
ityavagamya śāmbhatu bhavān |
tarhi tantudvayasaṃyogasya asamavāyikāraṇabhūtasya bahutantu- vyāpipaṭahetutvāt vyabhicāra iti cenna, tatrāpi vibhāga- dvāreṇa utpādakatvāt |
tathāhi, tantudvayasaṃyogaḥ prathame svāśraye tantudvaye paṭabhāgamutpādayati, utpanna paṭabhāgena tantvantarasya saṃyogāt svāśraye paṭabhāgāntaram ityevamuttara- trāpyūhyam |
ato na vyabhicāraḥ |
iti vaṇyukāyu- ptātvāpi draṣṭavyam |
athavā yāvatāṃ saṃyogānāmekasmin kārye asamavāyikāraṇatvam, tāvantameva svāśrayādi- vyāptiḥ |
ata ekakāryatve'pi mahāpaṭasya na vyabhi- cāraḥ |
athavā yatraikasmin kārye ekasyaiva asamavāyi- kāraṇatvam, tatraiveyaṃ vyāptiḥ |
prayatnavadātmaśarīrasaṃyoga- sveka eveti na kaściddoṣaḥ |
nanu yadā prayatnavadātma- śarīrasaṃyogāt śarīre vibhāgasaṃyogotpattiḥ, tadā prayatna- vadātmadeśasaṃyogāt deśe'pīti na tadatiriktakarmānu- ṣṭhānam |
naivam, deśaśarīravibhāgasaṃyogasyaiva kāryam |
ata ekasminneva kārye prayatnavadātmaśarīrasaṃyogasya prayatnavadātmadeśasaṃyogasya ca hetutvāt nāmnāśarīra- gasya vā astrāśraye deśe kāryakaratvam, ātmadeśasaṃyo- gasyāpi svāśraye śarīre iti |
kiñca ātmadeśa- saṃyogasyāpi hetṛtvaṃ na klaptam, kalpanīyam, tadare karmakalpanām |

paramārthatastu na ke'pi vināśahetavaḥ |

na ca ekalaiva ghaṭasya nānārūpatvaṃ saṃbhavati, nānā- taikalyavirodhāt, tasmāt kṣaṇamagnyatvaṃ ghaṭādeḥ |

ato hetvantarāpekṣatvaviruddhanirapekṣatva- vyāptadhruvabhāvitvasya vā upalabdhiḥ; saivādhruvabhāvitvasyānu- paladhiḥ |
vināśasya hetvantarāpekṣā nāsti |
tathā yadi bhāvā api svahetubhyo vināśaṃ pratyapekṣeran, tatastasya hetvantarasya saṃnidhānaniyame pramāṇabhāvāt kaścit kṛto'pi na vinaśyet |
svahetostu vinaśvaratvopasya udayanāntaramapa ... iti kṣaṇabhaṅgaratvasiddhiḥ |
apicedaṃ cintanīyam |
kiṃ kṛtakā bhāvā svahetubhyaḥ samupājāya- mānā vināśrā eva jāyante avinaśvarā vā |
vinaśvarā udayāntarameva līyante iti kṣaṇabhaṅginaḥ |
avinaśvara- svabhāvāstu na kadāciddinaśyeyuḥ |
na ca hetvantarātteṣāṃ vināśodayaḥ, vikalpasahatvāt |
sa hi jāyamāne vināśo bhāvāt anyatirekī vyatirekī vā ? na tāvadvyatirekī, hetubhedāt |
vyatirekiṇi tu jāte bhāvasya prāgvat upalabdhyādiprasaṅgaḥ |
tena tirodhīyate iti kalpanāyāmapi tirodhānaṃ pratyeva vikalpa ityalamatiprasaṅgena |
atra kecidevaṃ samādadhati |
taccedante parasparasaṃvalite samākalyadeke pratyabhijñāsākhyātaṃ pratyakṣavijñānaṃ kṣaṇa- bhaṅgānumānaṃ niruṇaddhīti |
na cedamiha samīcīnam |
dve ete vijñāne grahaṇamaraṇarūpe yathārthaṃ tanmātrātre idantāmātre ca vyāpriyamāṇe nālamubhayānusaṃbhavasamaya- vartitām arthasya avabhāsayitumiti, pratītivirodhāt |
yathaiva khalu abhinnadeśakālaṃ vastu ekatayā cakāsti, tathā atrāpi bhinnadeśakālamapi ekatayaiva parisphuratīti |
tathāvidhasaṃvedanodayaśca naikavijñānamantareṇa itye kamevedaṃ vijñānamurarīkaraṇīyam |
kāryaśraddhāvopapādanāya apratīta- mapi kāraṇaṃ parikalpanīyam |
na punaḥ kāraṇamanirīkṣaṇena spaṣṭadṛṣṭakāryaviparyayaḥ paryālocanīyaḥ |
tena yadyapi kevalā- dindriyāt kevalāt pūrvānubhavasamāsāditajanamo bhāvanā- 'dhimānāt saṃskārāt nedamevavidhaṃ vijñānamudetumarhati, tathāpi tayoranyonyasamavadhānasamāsāditadaśantarayoḥ idaṃ kāryamityācāryāḥ, na cedamapyucitam |
pratyakṣemeva na bhavatīti |
satyapi saṃskārayoge indriyavyāpārādhīna- janmatā asya prathamasamāgamasamayabhāvinaḥ sakalatvādinā- mapyahitatvādānāṃ pratyakṣasaṃmatāt aviśeṣāt |
na cedaṃ pramāṇābhāsamiti kiñcana pramāṇamasti |
bādhakakāraṇadoṣa- saṃvedanantaravirahād nedamevānumānaṃ bādhakamiti nimitta- cittamanujayate, parasparaśrayadopasamāsatteḥ |
yāvat
khalvetad vijñānamabādhitam, tāvadanumānameva nodetuṃ prabhavati, saṃjātavati cānumāne bādhitamidaṃ bhavati iti viśadataramitaretarakāraṇatvam |
avādhitaviṣayatā cāpi kāraṇamanumānodaye |
anyathā hutavahe śītatā kimiti nānumīyate |
nanvevaṃ tarhi kathaṃ jvālādīnāmekatvam avacāritānāmanumānato medasiddhiḥ |
atra siddhānta- sāramudīrayanti |
sāmānyaviśeṣātmakāni sarvavastūni |
tatra jvālā''diṣu dṛṣṭamagnā, sāmānyaviṣayamanumānaṃ tu viśeṣaviṣayamiti bhinnagocarapracāriṇoḥ |
pratyakṣānumāna- yorvirodhābhāvāt na pratyakṣeṇānumānodayavirodhaḥ |
kathaṃ punarakṣaṇikasya arthakriyākāritā krameṇeti vada |
sa khalu sahakārisamavadhānopahitaviśeṣo bhāvaḥ tātārtha- kriyāṃ krameṇaiva saṃpādayati |
nanu vikalpitaṃ sahakāribhiḥ kiṃ vyatirikta'vyatiriktaṃ viśeṣa ādhīyate iti |
dūṣaṇāni ceha vikalpyatve pūrvamāveditāni |
atrāpi ta eva pratiniyāmakam ... yadinā ayamekāntaḥ asmākaṃ minnānyeva sarvavastūni, na minnāni ceti, kintu sarvabhāveṣu medābhedau saṃgiramahe |
tatra medāmavikalpasaṃbhāvinī dūṣaṇāni amedāśrayeṇa parihṛtāni |
amedāmāśritāni ca medāvalambaneneti |
nanvetena medābhedī kathamekatra virodhinī niveśite |
tatrāhaḥ |
nemau virodhinau, sahadarśa- nāt |
sahānavasthānalakṣaṇo hi virodhaḥ |
anavasthānaṃ ca darśananicandhanam, nāsti virodhaḥ |
tadidamimavicārita- ramaṇīyamiti gurūṇāṃ nānumatam |
sa hi na dadarśa medā- medāveva tāvadekatra na saṃbhavataḥ |
virodhāt |
nahi tayoḥ sahadarśanamupapadyate |
ekākārapratītireva khalu amedādarśa- nam |
vilakṣaṇākārapratītiśca medadarśanam |
tatra yathaika ākāraḥ pratītaḥ, tathā vilakṣaṇākārapratītirnāsti |
vila- kṣaṇakāre ca pratīyate naikākārapratītireva nāsti (asti) tena minnāminnaviśeṣaāśrayeṇa arthakriyāsamarthanameghaṭa- mānam |
na ca pratyabhijñānānumānavirodhaḥ |
pratyabhijñāyā eva parīkṣaṇīyatvāt |
dṛṣṭā śuktikāyāṃ tadevadaṃ rajatami- mati |
sā ca sādṛśyavaśenaiva medāgrahaṇātibandhanaiveti yuktā atrāpi parīkṣā |
tatra parīkṣamāṇasya arthakriyā'- nuparattyā kṣaṇike nirṇate sahadaśapararā''pattivipralambhaḥ ayamiti niśrīyate |
bhavati ca vimuśato ... hutavahā- diṣnumānaśena jātāyā api pratīterviparyayaḥ |
hutavahādiṣu cauṣṇyapratītirupājātā parīkṣyamāṇā'pi nānyayopapadyate ... iti na viparyayānumānodayaḥ |
tassādalamena nānāṭakarūpapatitena ... darśanenāti- nirvandhena gambhīrataragurudarśanasāgarapāradṛśvānastu saṃprati samādhimabhidadhati |
sambhādiṣu prathamamanu- bhūteṣu punarantarā tirodhānādivaśena vicchinnopalambhepu punaranubhavataḥ sa evāyamiti tāvajjāyate matiḥ |
tatra yadi arthakriyā sthirā'pi kathañcidupāpadyate, tato medāgrahaṇanibandhano'yamamedabhramaḥ iti kimiti kalpyate |
upapadyate ca sthirā'pi sahakāriviśeṣa- jātāgantukakriyā''dirūpaviśeṣabhājanaḥ krameṇārthakriyā |
sa ca viśeṣo vyatirikta eva bhāvāt arthakriyākāriṇam (ṇaḥ) |
na ca sa eva arthakriyākārī, bhāvantvā'ste iti caturaham |
tathā vidhiviśeṣā- līḍhataiva tasya sādhanatā, yadantaramarthakriyodayaḥ, tadvi- śeṣayogitayaiva bhāveṣu sādhanatvavyavahāro laukikānām |
kathaṃ punarasau viśeṣaḥ tasyeti yadyapyasyate, tadāśraya- tayaivānumānāt |
kathaṃ punastadāśrayatvaiva, svahetudarśaneti matvā nivartatāṃ bhavān |
alamasmābhiridaṃmayātā |
atha kasmāt bhāvasya medo nānumīyate ? pratyabhijñānānu- guṇāditi vadāmaḥ |
dṛṣṭānusāri cānumānamucitam, dṛṣṭo- papattimupalakṣyatām |
yathā ca arthakriyākāritā, tathedamāpi dṛśyate sthāvaro bhāva iti tadanuguṇamanumānamucitam |
tena sthāvare'pi arthakriyāvyāpakakramayogapadyānivṛtte- siddho vyāpakanupalambhā ... tadasiddhena viparyaye bādhakā- bhāvāt asiddhatamāntrātnubandhinī kṣaṇikatā na sattā sādhayitumalamau, anaikāntikatvāditi |
na ca arthakriyā- kāritvaiva sattā, kintu pramāṇasambandhayogyatā |
svarūpasattā ca pramāṇasambandhayogyatā |
atārthakriyākurvvapi sanniti na kiñcidvadyam |
yaścidapyayamānaṃ anapekṣābhāvā vināśapratītiḥ, tadapi vimṛśyamānaṃ jātupamivābharaṇaṃ viśiryate |
kai khalu bhavanto vināśamabhimayante |
pradhvaṃsā- bhāvo vināśa iti cet, kaḥ punaḥ pradhvaṃsābhāvaḥ |
dadhi
kṣaṇabhaṅgavādakhaṇḍanaṃ
kṣīre nāstītyemādikā bhāvaviṣayā saṃviditi yadyucyate, tadā amṛtakalāyāmuditā nītiruddharaṇīyā|
nahi nāstīti buddhirasti|
kintu dadhirūpamātrāṇubhave eva svayaṃ- prakāśe śabdaprayogamātrame..tasaiva..payaso nāsti|
tāhaśatre...tasmin dadhirūpamātrāṇopalabdhiḥ|
na ca tāṃ prati payasa eva nirapekṣasya hetutā|
anupanipāte hetvantare payasaḥ evopalabdheḥ|
na cedaṃ payo'ntaramupalabhyate iti śakyaṃ vaktum|
pratyabhijñānasya abhedāsādhakatvāt|
nanu ca hetvantarāpekṣitve śrutābhavitā nopapadyate|
śrutābhavitā kuto'vagamyate|
darśanāditi cet, hetva- ntareṇāvadayaṃ bhaviṣyatīti|
na ca vālāḥ, yenaivaṃ- vidhavādāt bhīṣyāmahai|
yantu punaridaṃ svehetubhyo bhāvā- nāmapi naśvarāṇāmupaco hetvantarāyate vināśe vyatirekiṇi jāte'pi pūrvavat bhāvasya upalabdhyādiprasaṅga iti|
atrocyate|

kṣamecchinyāya: 1532 kṣamavatyādīnāṃ kṣīraṃ vihāya 1533 khaṭvādyau
kṛsnakṣāme eva prāyaścittam |
upasaṃprāptaṃ hi nimittaṃ yacchāstroktam, 'puroḍāśau kṣāyataḥ' iti |
kṛsnasya kṣatirnādyavasya |
na caikadeśakṣāme, tasyāvarjanīyatvāt |
atha yaduktam, kṣāmeṇa haviṣā samāptirhṛdyate, yadā tadviḥ saṃtiṣṭhate |
ucyate |
saṃkhāne nimitte prāya- ścittam |
yadā'pi anyenāpi haviṣā tat saṃsthāpyate, tadā'pi prāyaścittamiti na doṣaḥ |
tadviḥśabdāditi cet |
bhāṣyam - evaṃ ceducyate, anyena haviṣā yadā saṃsthāpyate iti |
naivam |
tadviḥśabdāt |
tadviḥśabdo- 'tra bhavati 'yadā tadviḥ saṃtiṣṭhate' iti |
anyānyena haviṣā saṃsthāpyamāne tadviḥśabdo nākalpyeteti |
syādijyāgāmī haviḥśabdastalliṅgasaṃyogāt |
bhāṣyam - syādijyāgāmī haviḥśabdaḥ |
tadviḥ saṃtiṣṭheta tadviḥśabde karma saṃtiṣṭheteti |
nanu mukhyābhāve gauṇo gṛhyate, nānyatheti |
ucyate |
mukhyābhāvaḥ evā- yam |
katham ? yadā saṃtiṣṭheta tatkarma, tena haviṣeti vākyaṃ bhidyeta |
avācakaṃ ca syāt |
phamena hi saṃtiṣṭhate, na haviḥ |
tena saṃkhāne nimittam |
tadvirityanuvādaḥ |
anuvādaśca anyahaviṣke'pi karmaṇi saṃsthite prāyaścitta- miti gamyate |
kathaṃ punaḥ haviḥśabdaḥ karmaṇi vartate iti ? talliṅgayogāt |
haviḥsaṃbaddhaṃ karma haviḥśabdena haviḥ- saṃjñanvādagamyate |
yathā prasaṅkāritayā devadattasaṃbaddhayā lakṣyate siṃhaḥ |
evaṃ haviṣā'pi karma lakṣyate |
tasmāt kṛsnakṣāme prāyaścittamiti |
soma - yadā agniḥ paktvā kapālāṃnāṃ sāmyam, udakasecanādikaṃ ca apekṣitaparimāṇam |
tadā alpāṃśa- dāhādeva adanīyaphalakapākotpattiḥ |
yadā tu paktvā- dikamanevaṃvidham, tadā ka cit bahuḥvaṃśadāhāt antaradanīyatvam, ka cicca ekasyārthasya atyanta- dāhāt ardhāntarasya adanīyatvam, iti sarvatra ekadeśadāhasya adanīyaphalakapākāntarīyakatayā tadvi- lakṣaṇasya ekadeśadāhasya vaktumaśakyāt na nimittatvam |
evaṃ ca tatra madhyapūrvādhamātram atidagdham itastu adanīyapakam, tatrāpi madhyapūrvādhayoḥ avadānadeśa- mātratayā svayaṃ haviṣvābhāvāt puroḍāśasyaiva haviṣṭvāt, tasya ca sadbhāvāt yathāvatkāśe dviravadāya hotavyam |
na ca sarvakṣaṇe tasya haviṣā evābhāvāt 'yadā tadviḥ saṃtiṣṭhate' ityetat kathamupapadyate iti vācyam |
puroḍāśa haviryasya iti bahuvrīhiṇā tadviḥśabdasya yāgaparatvāt yāgasya saṃsthāsaṃjñanvāt |
tathā ca sarvakṣāme'pi 'yasya sarvāṇi havīṃṣi' iti vacanāt ājyena tadvirupalakṣita- yāgasya samāptiḥ saṃbhavati, iti na kaścidoṣaḥ |
vi-- 'kṣāme yāgo dvayoḥ : sarvadāhe vā, pūrvavad dvayoḥ |
, aṃśādāhasya nityatvāt sarvadāhe punaryejiḥ |
' bhāṭṭa - 'yasya puroḍāśau kṣāyatastaṃ yaṃ varuṇo gṛhṇāti, yadā tadviḥ saṃtiṣṭhate atha tadeva havirnirvepat' iti śrutaprāyaścitte sarvapuroḍāśadāhaṇaṃ kṣāmameva nimittam |
agnipāke haviṣi ekadeśadāhasya avarja- nīyatvāt |
na ca avarjanīyakṣāmānatiriktadeśadāhasyaiva nimittatvam, tasyaiva paricchedumaśakyatvāt |
na ca 'tadviḥ saṃtiṣṭhate' iti śravaṇāt avaśiṣṭena haviṣā yāgapratīteḥ ekadeśadāhasyaiva nimittatvam, prayogasamā- sāveva evaṃjātīyaśabdaprayogasya sarvatra darśanena prayoga- samāptaiva lakṣaṇayā prakṛte'pi pratipādanīyatvāt |
ataḥ sarvakṣāme evaidaṃ punaḥprayogarūpaṃ prāyaścittam |
'yadvaidyaṃ havirmāṃpaṃceta, anyattadaiva nirvapet' ityāpastamba- vacanāt sarvadāhe prāyaścittam |
'yadi vā'vadānebhyo na prabhavet' ityāpastambena sarvadāhe avadānāparyāptaikadeśadāhe vā punaḥprayogavidhānena tannirvaikadeśadāhe prāyaścittā- nupapatteḥ |
ata eva ekadeśadāhasya pariccheduṃ śakyatve- 'pi etanmūlabhūtaśrutyaiva tatra prāyaścittasaṃbhavaḥ |
tādṛśa- deśadāhe tu prāktananāśādhikaraṇanyāyena ājyena dagdhā- vaśiṣṭena vā prayogasamāptimātram |
evaṃ sarvakṣāme'pi prayogasamāptiḥ ājyena puroḍāśāntarotpatyā vā draṣṭavyā |
maṇḍana - 'kṣāme'tra kṛsne yattervidhānam |
' śaṃkara - 'sarvakṣaṇanimittā |

tathāhi, yadyapi na irāpadasya stotrāpūrve upayoga:, tathāpi guṇābhidhānarūpasya kāryasya girāpadairāpadyo: ekatvāt yuktastathā dharmalābha: |
yadyapi ca guṇābhidhānasvarūpārthā dharmā:, tathāpi guṇābhidhāna- janyasya apūrvasya etasyaiva agniṣṭomastotre cayanādau copayogāt, dharmāṇāṃ ca gītyādīnāṃ girāpadakāryaguṇā- bhidhānajanyāvāntarapūrvaprayuktatvasya dīkṣaṇīyātrāṅganiyama- nyāyena aṅgīkārātu cayanāpūrvasādhanībhūtagirāpadāntara- kāryāpanne agniṣṭomastotrāpūrvasādhanībhūtakāryajanake irāpade yuktaiva taddharmaprāpti: |
mā'stu vā avāntarakārya- bhedamīṅgīkṛtya kāryāpattiḥ; tathāpi girāpadabādhakatvā tasthānāpatti: tāvadasye irāpadasya |
ataśca irāpadasya prakaraṇāt stotrāttve avagate gītirūpadharmāṅgābhyāṃ bādhakatvalakṣaṇānapatyā upasthitasya girāpadasya dharmati- deśe na kiñcidvādhakam asti |
āvaśyakaṃ ca gīte: cayanāpūrvasādhanībhūtagirāpadālakṣatvam |
vastutastu, yathaiva ' yajñiyajñiyaṃ pṛcche gāyati ' iti vacanena yajña- yajñiyasya cayane upayoga:, tathaiva ' yajñāśayena stuvīta ' iti vacanena agniṣṭomastotre'pi |
ataśca tadgatagīrya- śasya yāvat cayane svāśrayagirāpadopayogakalpanādvārā cayanopayogakalpanām, tāvat tattvameva agniṣṭoma- stotrāṅgabhūtagirāpadadhārakatvakalpanā stotropayogo'pi iti upadeśenaiva tanmātrenaṃ girāpadagīte: irāpade atideśa: |
yadyapi ca agniṣṭomastotre'pi ārdhike purastāduparidhāt girāpadasyāpi upayogāt tatsthānāpatti: irāpadasya agni- ṣṭomastotrāvacanatvasya samānatvātvādiśaṅkyeta, tathāpi ārcikodrīyayo: avāntarakāryabhedāt amede'pi vā apragītasya girāpadasya ārcike pāṭhāt girāpadagīte: girāpadadvārā cayanādāveva upayogena agniṣṭomastotre upayogābhāvāt tarkāryāpatyā atideśena taddhīta: irāpade atideśa: ūho vā, apitu uparītyā upadeśenaiva |
tattvaṃ tu ' airaṃ kulodreyam ' ityatra na irāpadakṣarāṇi vidhīyante, girāpadayuktepāṭhe'pi tatsatvāt, apitu niṣedhānuvādatvāt gakāraparisaṃkhyāmātraṃ vidhīphalam, ataśca gīte: ' gāirāgātrā cā dākṣāsā ' ityevaṃ- vidhāya girāpadavṛttitvena samatāyā vastuta: irākṣaradharma- tvāt gakārasattve iva tadasadapyeva svāśrayavṛttitvākṣate: na girāpadagīte: irāpade svatantra: upadeśaḥ, na vā ati- deśa: ūho vā |

( pūrvādheṃ bhāṣyaśrutivākyaśabdabhyāṃ saṃnikarṣaviprakarṣau uktau ityarthaḥ |
uttarārdhena tu aṣṭaprakāraṃ saṃnikarṣaviprakarṣā- bhidhānaṃ pratijñātam ) sarvaprakāram āmiṣvā saṃbandhasya saṃnikarṣalakṣaṇaṃ śrautatvam, vājinasaṃbandhe ca viprakarṣāt vākyīyatvam |
( āmiṣvāyāṃ sāmānyato devatā'nyā- bhidhānam, na vājinasya iti prathamaṃ prakāramāha - ) tad yathā, yadyapi tāvat dravyaviśeṣasya taddhito na brūyāt devatātvam, tathāpi sāmānyasya tāvat bravīti, na caturthyantena sāmānyamapi ucyate iti viśeṣaḥ |
yattu sāmānyaṃ vājine'pi aviruddhamiti, tadayuktam |
vaiśva- devī iti hi śrīpratyayena samānapadatenaiva klībatvaṃ kimapi saṃnihitamityavācyate |
na ca vājinasya strītvaṃ saṃnidhirvā asti ityanāśrayam |
( dadātikalpanā- kalpanarūpaṃ dvitīyaṃ prakāramāha - ) apica ' vājibhyo vājinaṃ kuryāditi naivāsti saṃgatiḥ |
tatra tallisa- cchye'vaśyaṃ dānādyāhārakalpanā |
' kartavyatā- vacanam āmiṣvākye'pi adhyāhārāt prayogavacanadāhā lambyamiti na paryanuyujyate |
' vājibhyo vājinam ' iti tu dadātimanadhyāhṛtya na śakyaḥ saṃbandhaḥ pratyetuṃ yathā ' vaiśvadevī āmiṣvā ' iti |
kutaḥ ? ' nāmnāṃ dvidhaiva saṃbandhaḥ sarvavākyeṣvavasthitaḥ |
sāmā- nādhikaraṇyaṃ ṣaṣṭhyā vā padayāmaḥ |
na ca vājibhyaḥ sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ ṣaṣṭhyā vā padayāmaḥ |
na ca vājibhyaḥ iti kārakabhaktiḥ kriyāpadat anyena saṃbadhyate, na ceha tadupāttam |
tatra adhyāhārakalpanāt eko viprakarṣaḥ, tripadasaṃbandhagauravāt aparaḥ |
itaratrāpi yaji- kalpanāt aśeṣa iti cet na, tasya saṃbandhottara kālānumeyatvāt |
vaiśvadevyāmiṣvā iti hi niṣpanne saṃbandhe yajiḥ anumīyate, na taddhīnā saṃbandha- pratītiḥ |
tava tu parasvatvāpādanasaṃbhavāt sa ca bhavi- ṣyati arthasaṃbandhārtham, āditaśca dravyadevatākavākya- tvasiddhaye dadātiḥ iti viśeṣaḥ |
kalpite ca dadātī kārakayoḥ parasparasaṃbandhatvāt tena tāvat saha saṃbandhaḥ, tataḥ ekārthatvāt parasparaniyamaḥ iti viprakṛṣṭatā |
na tu āmiṣvāyāṃ taddhit kiñcit iti saṃnikarṣaḥ |
( sāmānādhikaraṇyavaidhakaraṇalakṣaṇaṃ tṛtīyaṃ prakāramāha - ) satyāpi ca vājivājinayoḥ sākṣātsaṃbandhe vaidhikaraṇyat viprakṛṣṭatvam |
vaiśvadevī āmiṣvā iti tu sāmānādhi- karaṇāt saṃnikṛṣṭatā |
tathā ca vakṣyati ( 3|1|6|12 ityatra mādhyam ) ' samarthatarāṇi hi samānavibhaktīni bhavanti, durbale viviktiḥ ' iti |
( śrutalakṣaṇā- ''tmakaṃ caturthaṃ prakāramāha - ) kiñca ' saṃpradānatvamātraṃ ca caturthī vājināṃ vadet |
devatā lakṣyāmāṇā tu punardravye vājine |
' nahi taddhitavat devatāyāṃ caturthyutpattiḥ smaryate |
kva tarhi ? saṃpradāne |
na ca saṃpradānasyaiva devatātvam, mā bhūt ' hiraṇyamātreyāya dadāti ' ityatra ātreyo devatā |
yadi ca devatā saṃpradānaṃ syāt, tato yāgadānayorameda eva syāt |
pratigrahe vyāpṛtaṃ ca kārakaṃ saṃpradānaṃ bhavati |
na ca devatāyāḥ pratigrahītṛtvaṃ saṃbhavati |
tena avaśyaṃ yaḥ saṃpradānatvāt prāgbhāvī taduddeśaḥ ( tasyāḥ devatāyāḥ uddeśaḥ ), sa caturthyā lakṣayitavyaḥ |
yadvā parasvatvāpādana- saṃbandhottarakālabhāvi aiśvaryam, tādātmyaprasiddhedevatā- tvasya |
yadyapi anirākaraṇātmakasaṃpradānameva devatā ityabhyupagamaḥ, tathāpi sāmānyena vyabhicāraviśeṣalakṣa- ṇāt viprakṛṣṭatvam |
( saṃdigdhatvātsaṃdigdhalakṣaṇaṃ pañcamaṃ prakāramāha - ) apica ' caturthīpañcamīrūpasaṃdehāt viprakṛṣṭatā |
' taddhitasya tvasaṃdehāt na buddhirvi- prakṛṣyate |
' vājibhyaḥ iti rūpasāmānyāt prasaktaṃ sat yāvat pañcamītvamapanīya caturthītvaṃ sādhyate, tāvat mativiśeṣaḥ |
nanu taddhite'pi anekapadārthārthasaṃdehāt tulyametat |
viṣama upanyāsaḥ |
' śabdasaṃdeho mayā upa- nyastaḥ, tvayā arthasaṃdehaḥ |
sarvathā tāvat taddhitatvama- saṃdigdham |
arthaḥ punaḥ yogyatvāt itarāsaṃbhavena devatā- tmako nirṇeyate |
bhavatsu nirṇīte'pi śabde caturthyarthā- neruktvāt upapadakāraka lakṣaṇasaṃdehāt asyaiva viprakarṣaḥ |
tena arthasaṃdehaḥ ubhayoḥ samatvāt naikaśraute |
śabda- saṃdehestu asādhāraṇatvāt coditaḥ |
( ityayupañcādiṣṭa- tvalakṣaṇaṃ ṣaṣṭhaṃ prakāramāha - ) kiñca ' āmiṣvātyeya- mānena karmaṇā saha yujyate |
tato vākyāntaropapātta-
supraśnena tu vājinam ||
' yathā ca utpattiśiṣṭasya balīyastvam , na ca kriyāmātraṃ niṣkṛṣya guṇāntaraṃ vidhātuṃ śakyate, tathoktaṃ citrā'dhikaraṇe vaiśvadevādhikaraṇe ca |
vaiśvadevādhikaraṇasya ca prakaraṇamapekṣitamyapara vājinākyena |
kutaḥ ? ' dravyadevatāsambandho yāga- mātramapekṣate |
ābhikṣāyāga eveti tatra prakaraṇād bhavet |
' vājinaṃ hi vinā yāgena vājibhirna saṃvadhyate, iti kaścit yāgamapekṣate |
tatra yat ābhikṣāyāgasyaiva tadapi aṅgam iti kalpyate tatprakaraṇāt, tataśca yadyapi vākyenaiva ābhikṣāyāge viśve devā vidhīyante, tathāpi anyanirapekṣavihitātvāt ābhikṣāyāḥ prakaraṇāpekṣavākyavihitāt vājināt balīyastvaṃ bhavet iti viśeṣaḥ |
prakaraṇānapekṣayāgasaṃbandhe ca anyeṣāmiha apratīteḥ apūrvayāgaḥ saṃvandhī bhavati iti bhedaḥ |
na ca evamādīnāmanupāttapuruṣavyāpārāṇām ananumite yāge vākyānatarāpekṣā asti, ityuktamāmeyādiṣu (1|4|6|9) |
(rūḍhiyaugikatvalakṣaṇaṃ saptamaṃ prakāramāha -) ' viśve devāśca rūḍhayaiva saṃvadhyante payasayā |
vājinena tu saṃvandho bhavedayavātugaḥ |
' vājinaḥ iti hi avayavaprasiddhyā viśve devāḥ pratyāyyante |
vākyārthavacca avayavārthau samuccitya saṃvandhaṃ kalpayitvā sā bhavantī (avayava- prasiddheḥ ) śrutimātranipātalabhyāyāḥ samudāyaprasiddheḥ durbalā bhavati, iti durbalataraḥ saṃyogo vājinasya |
' vājinabdo'pi vā''dau sunirūḍhaḥ svabhāvataḥ |
kleśenaiva vinā kāryād viśvedeveṣu vartate |
' devatātvaṃ nāma yasyaiva śabdenoktaṃ tasyaiva yogyasya ayogasya vā bhavati iti na jātinimittam, yenāyaṃ vājinaśabdo balāt anyatra nīyeta |
ataśca vājinaśabdaḥ ajñānāṃ devatātvaṃ vadan vinā kāryeṇa durbalā avayava- prasiddhyā viśvadeveṣu kalpyate iti viprakarṣaḥ |
' satya- pyavayavārthe ca vājinasyā'pi (vājinī anyā ) devatā |
puroḍāśādinetyevaṃ kleśāt prakṛtani- śrāyaḥ |
sarve hi agnyādayaḥ puroḍāśādibhiranaiḥ vājino vijñāyante |
tatra ābhikṣāyāṃ tāvat annaśabdaḥ prayuktaḥ, na puroḍāśādau ityekaḥ kleśaḥ |
punarapi ca ābhikṣā- mātragrahaṇe sati vaiśvadevyā ābhikṣādyaiva taddtāṃ grahaṇam, ityaparaḥ |
tataśca sva rasena śrutiḥ anyatrāpi vartamānā satī prakaraṇena viśeṣe sthāpayitavyā na ca tatra kiñcinnimitta- masti, guṇabhāvenopādīyamānatvāt devatāyāḥ |
satkāryatve ca ' brīhīna prokṣati ' ityādiṣviva kathamapyapūrvasādhana- lakṣaṇayāṃ prākṛtagrahaṇaṃ bhavet, na cātra tadasti vinā'pi tena krameṇa : prayojanavaccopapatteḥ |
kāmaṃ vājinasyaiva pratipattiḥ saṃskāro bhavet, na devatāyāḥ |
prakṛtagrahaṇe ca agnyādīnāṃ sadbhāvāt anavadhāraṇam |
atha viśva- deveṣu sarvaiḥ saṃgṛhītā bhaviṣyanti iti teṣāṃ grahaṇam, tadayuktam, sarvasaṃgrahasya apramāṇakatvāt |
bahuvacana- śrutyā sarvagrahaṇāmiti cet, na |
tasya triṣveva caritārtha- tvāt |
na ca triṣu avadhāraṇajñānamiti cet, na |
' mukhyaṃ vā pūrvacodanālokoktam ' (1|2|8|12) ityavadhāraṇahetusadbhāvāt |
tasmāt na viśvadevagrahaṇe kiñcit pramāṇam |
sākāṅkṣa ca devatā dravyeṇa saṃvadhyeta sā cātra vājinaśabdena dravyavatī eva upādīyamānā nirā- kāṅkṣatayā pratyāyitā iti na dravyāntarasaṃvandhaṃ kṣamate |
( saptamaṃ prakāramupasaṃharati -) tasmāt atulyabalatvam |
kiñca ' śrutyaiva samavāyitvaṃ devatānāṃ svaka- rmasu |
viśvadevaśrutistatra vājinaśabdena durlabhā |
' yadi hi vājināye'pi viśve devā eva devatātvena abhyupagamyante, tato'vaśyaṃ nigamasthāneṣu viśvadevaśrutireva uccāraṇīyā |
sā cātra vidhiṃśabde anuccāritatvāt aśakyā labdhum |
tatra evaṃ kleśena labhyeta, vāji- śabdaḥ kiñciddhatte vadati, so'pi rūpāmadhāyāt viśva- devaśabdaṃ lakṣayati, tato'sau vājinatayaiva ācāryā- māṇatvena vidhīyate iti kleśāḥ |
tatrāpi ca arthena śabdalakṣaṇayāmāviśeṣāt ' sarve devāḥ ' ' niḥśeṣā devāḥ ' ityādayaḥ sarve prāpnuvanti, iti viśva- devaśabdo durlabhaḥ |
na ca anyaśabdoccāraṇe teṣāṃ devatātvaṃ bhavati ' vidhiśabdasya mantratve bhāvaḥ ' (10|4|1|21 23) iti vakṣyati |
vājinaśabde eva atra puruṣaḥ śāstreṇa pravartitaḥ iti taduccāraṇenaiva vājinasya devatā saṃpādanīyā |
tataśca yadyapi viśvadevārtha eva iha vāji-
śabdena uccyamāno devatā bhavati, itaratra viśvadevaśabdena, tathāpi mahendranyāyena ( 2|1|5|13 ) viniyogabhedāt vispaṣṭaṃ devatāpṛthaktvam iti aparo'yaṃ dravyadevatāsaṃbandho vijñāyate |
na ca prāpte karmaṇi anekāryaguṇavidhānaṃ saṃbhavati |
iti upapadyametat ' guṇapūrvāvasaṃyoge bhedakaḥ ' iti |
aguṇe tu karmaśabde guṇastatra pratīyate |

yuktaṃ yat tatra guṇavidhānam, na tatra aprakṛtena kena cit guṇena saṃgrahaḥ, prakṛtena tu asti yāgena |
tasmāt anupavarṇanametat |

prakṛtāstān yadecchuyā vājinaśabdaśca yaugikaḥ |

soma - saṃjñā'nantaraṃ saṃnihitāt karmaṇo medakatva- sāmānyāt guṇasyaiva vyutpādanaṃ yuktam iti saṃgatiḥ |

mī. ko. 199
bhāṭṭa - ' vaiśvadevyābhikṣā ' ityatra dravyadevatāviśiṣṭe yāge vihite tadanuvādena ' vājibhyo vājinam ' ityatra na guṇamātravidhiḥ |
prāptakarmānuvādena anekaguṇavidhāne vākyabhedāpatteḥ |
na ca yājam annam ābhikṣārūpaṃ vidyate yeṣāmiti vyutpatyā viśvān devān tadviśiṣṭayāgaṃ vā uddiśya vājinamātrasya samuccayena vikalpena vā vidhi- rastviti vācyam |
vājinaśabdasya rūḍhatvena viśvadevānu- vādānupapatteḥ |
utpattiśiṣṭadravyavarodhe dravyāntarasya niveśā- nupapatteśca |
etena ābhikṣā'nuniṣpannavājinasaṃbandhaprāptyā vājinapadam ābhikṣāyāganāmadheyamaṅgīkṛtya taduddeśena vājidevatāvidhirityāpattirastam |
utpattiśiṣṭadevatā'varodhe devatā'ntarasya niveśānupapatteḥ |
kiñca, ābhikṣāyāḥ pārthiko devatāsaṃbandhaḥ; padaśrutyā, vājinasya tu vākyeneti daurbalyam |
taddhitasya hi devatātvaviśiṣṭe dravyaviśeṣe śaktiḥ; ābhikṣāpadaṃ ca tātparyagrāhakamiti prājñaḥ |
ābhikṣā''dau dravye devatātve ca bhinnā śaktiḥ, nirūpakatvaṃ tu saṃsargaḥ |
devatātve eva vā śaktiḥ, dravye lakṣaṇā |

guṇamukhyaviśeṣān |
‘saurye caruṃ nirvapet’ iti caruśabdena pradeyārthatvena vidhau codakaprāptaḥ mukhyaḥ puroḍāśo bādhyate |
śrapaṇārthatvena vidhau tu puroḍāśasya guṇabhūtāni kapālāni bādhyante |
prasaṅge guṇo bādhanīyaḥ na mukhyam iti guṇamukhyaviśeṣasya sattvāt caruśabdena syālī śrapaṇārthatvena vidhīyate iti yuktam |
tasmāt caruśabdārthaḥ syālī kapālavikāraḥ iti pūrvapakṣaḥ |
tacchuttau cānyahaviṣtvāt |
tacchuttau tasya caruśabdasya śrutau śravaṇe'pi anya- syaiva dravyasya ka cit haviṣtvaṃ dṛśyate |
yathā ‘prājāpatyaṃ ghṛte caruṃ nirvapet śatakṛṣṇalam’ iti vidhāya ‘catvāri- catvāri kṛṣṇalānavyavata’ ityuktam |
atra caruśabde śrute'pi kṛṣṇalanāmameva haviṣtvaṃ prasiddham |
evaṃ prakṛte'pi ‘saurye caruṃ nirvapet’ ityatrāpi caruḥ syālī syāt |
syālyāṃ ca śrutaṃ haviḥ syāt |
tasmāt caruśabdārthaḥ syālī, sā ca kapālavikāraḥ |
liṅgadarśanācca |
‘māsṛtaṃ caruṃ nirvapet pṛśnīnāṃ dugdhe praiyajñaṃ grāma- kāmaḥ’ iti vākye caruśabdārthaḥ syālī tathā priyajñvaḥ haviḥ iti anyaśca anyat haviḥ, tacca carī nāma syālyāṃ niṣpāditaḥ syāt |
idaṃ liṅgaṃ havirvirtve dṛśyate |
tathā ‘saurye caruṃ nirvapet’ ityatrāpi syāt |
tasmāt caruśabdārthaḥ syālī |
sā ca kapālavikāraḥ |
odano vā prayuktatvāt |

vāśabdaḥ pūrvapakṣavyāvṛttyarthaḥ |

vaiśvānareṣṭau aṣṭakapālamiṣṭiḥ dvādaśa- kapālaḥ|
na guṇavidhiḥ|
pūrveṇanto'dhivānātstasāmadhye samāmnāye|
bhāṣyam-- 'vaiśvānaraṃ dvādaśakapālaṃ nirvapet putre jāte' iti śrūyate|
tatra 'yad aṣṭakapāle bhavati gāya- tryeṇaiva brahmavarcasena punāti' ityevamādayaḥ kapāla- vikalpāḥ śrūyante|
teṣu saṃdehaḥ kim aṣṭakapālayo guṇa- vicayaḥ, uta arthavādā iti|
tatra guṇavidhayaḥ ityeva brūmaḥ|
katham? ye hi pūrvavanto viditaputramarthe abhi- vadanti, te avidhānārthāḥ|
tadetat asya vākyasya samāmnāye sāmarthyam, yat aviditapūrvakāmihānam|
kiṃ tat? vidhānasāmarthyam|
evamavihitameva vidhāsyati|
itarathā arthavādāḥ santaḥ|
anarthakāḥ syuḥ|
na ca dvādaśa- kapālasya śeṣabhāvamupagantumarhati|
pratyakṣa hi aṣṭānāṃ kapālānāṃ stutiḥ, parokṣā dvādaśānām|
pratyakṣābhāve ca parokṣā syāt|
tasmāt guṇavidhayaḥ|
vā-- guṇavidhitvameva vicāryate adhunā kevalaguṇavidhitvameva asti na vā iti vicāryate|
athavā aṣṭakapālatvasya vaiśvānarasāmānyādhikaraṇatvāt dvādaśa- kapālatvasya nāmadheyatvamāsādya guṇavidhiḥ|
prasiddhādibhiḥ prakṛtayajñuddheḥ tatpratyakṣatvābhāvācca samartha- nīyaḥ|
tatrāpi nirākṛtya arthavādāt pūrvasiddhaiva upasaṃha- ripyate|
( bhāṣyakārāntarakṛta-akāramaśleṣarahitasūtra- vyākhyānatyāgena akāraśleṣeṇa bhāṣyakṛtaḥ [ śabarā- cāryasya ] vyākhyāne kāraṇaṃ vaktum upanyāsāpūrvakaṃ tat dūṣayati-) tatra pūrvavat vidhānena arthavattvam, apūrvāṇāṃ nāmadheyatvāvadhāraṇāt, 'yadutpattāvapūrvam' iti|
tasmāt guṇavidhayaḥ aṣṭakapālaḥ iti cet|
tadyuktam|
nahi apūrvatvāt nāmadheyatvaṃ siddham|
apūrvatvāt hi yathaiva
laukikārthāparijñānāt na guṇavidhitvam, evaṃ vaidikakarmā- midhāyitvaṃ sutarāṃ prasiddham, na tu nāmadheyatvamapi na syāt|
satyeva ca sarvatra laukike'rthe sambhavihārādibhiḥ nāmadheyatā uktā|
tasmāt yathābhāṣyameva sūtrārthaḥ 'pūrvajñātārthavācitve nāmadheyārthavādane|
aprāpta- tvādihaite syurvaidhatvavikalpavat ||
' yadi hi vaiśvānarayāge aṣṭakadādyaḥ kutaścit prāptā bhaveyuḥ, tataḥ saṃvāddvāreṇa nāmadheyatvam arthavādā vā syāt|
na tu prāptirasti, kevaladvādaśatvavidhānāt|
tathāhi 'yadya- pyarthātmanā'syaiva mahāsaṃsthāsvantara|
apari- cchedakatvāt nādyau karmaviśeṣaṇam ||
' nahi sattā- mātreṇa saṃkhyā vyāpyate|
kiṃ tarhi? saṃkhyepyaparicchedena|
dvādaśatvena ca kapāleṣu paricchidyamāneṣu na aṣṭakādīnāṃ paricchedakatvam ityavidyamānatā|
yadyapi ca yathākathañcit astitvamabhyupagamyate, tathāpi etāvanamātraṃ bhavet 'aṣṭau bhavanti' iti, na tu 'yaṣṭakapālaḥ'|
iti saṃskṛtataddhito hyeṣaḥ|
( tatra ityanuvartamāne 'saṃskṛtaṃ bhakṣāḥ' [ pā0 4|2|16 saptamyantāt aṇ syāt saṃskṛte arthe, yat saṃskṛtaṃ bhakṣāḥ cet te syuḥ|
aṣṭasu kapāleṣu saṃskṛtaḥ aṣṭakapālaḥ puroḍāśaḥ] ityanena aṣṭasu kapāleṣu saṃskṛtam ityasminnarthe saṃkhyāpūraṇasya dviguṇena iṣṭā kapālaprātipadika vihitasya aṇūpratyayasya 'dvigorluga- napatye' [ pā0 4|1|88 dvigornimitte yastaddhitaḥ: ajādi- ranapatyarthaḥ, tasya luk syāt ] iti dviguparataddhita- luksamāreṇa lopāt aṣṭakapālaśabdasiddhiḥ|
) taddhitārtha- nimittaka samāsaḥ|
( 'taddhitārthottarapadasamāhāre ca' iti taddhitārthe viṣayabhūte diksaṃkhyayoḥ: samānādhikara- ṇyasamāsapravṛtteḥ saṃskārakatvasya upādhitvavādāt dvādaśa- tvaparicchinnānāṃ saṃskārakāṇāṃ aṣṭatvena paricchettuma- śakyatvāt aṣṭakapālaśabdānupapattiḥ) tau ca ( taddhita- samāsau ) sati sāmarthye bhavataḥ|
sāmarthye ca anyanira- pekṣatve bhavati|
sāpekṣatvāt dvādaśatvena aṣṭakapālasyaḥ, iti na dvādaśakapālaḥ aṣṭakapālaśabdāmidhānīyaṃ labhate|
tena svarūpasaṃkīrtanasya asattvāt prarocanam atharvada- taramāpadyeta|
na ca dvādaśatvavilakṣaṇaḥ aṣṭakavādeḥ
karmopayogaḥ sambhavati, saṃkhyātvāt|
yadyapi ca aṣṭakatvastutyā dvādaśatvaṃ stūyate, na tu aṣṭakapālasya dvādaśakapālasya stutiḥ, viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyayoḥ atyantabhedāt|
apica asyaiva dvādaśalasya ātmīyā stutiḥ 'jagadyaivāsin' iti|
tasmāt dvādaśatvena saha vikalpamānāḥ guṇavidhaya evaite'pi|
sarve cedaṃ vaikalpikamanekasaṃkhyāviśiṣṭavaiśvānara- vidhānāt ekameva upattivākyam, iti na balābala viśeṣaḥ|
( 'vaiśvānaraṃ dvādaśakapālaṃ nirvapet putre jāte|
yaṣṭakapāle bhavati, gāyatryeṇaiva brahmavarcasena punāti|
yannavakapāle bhavati, triṣṭubhevāsmin tejo dadhāti|
yat daśakapāle bhavati, virājaivāsmin annādyaṃ dadhāti|
yadekādaśakapāle bhavati, triṣṭubhevāsmin indriyaṃ dadhāti|
yad dvādaśakapāle bhavati jagatyaivāsmin paśūn dadhāti|
yasmin jāte etāmiṣṭiṃ nirvapati, pūta eva sa tejasva- nnāda indriyāvī paśūmān bhavati' iti ekameva utpatti- vākyam) tasmāt 'sāmarthyam' iti ca pūrvaprakṛta- yogyāpekṣatvāt vaiśvadevaparvakāditeyaḥ|
tadīyaṃ hi sāmarthyam asmin samāmnāye'sti, na ca taduktaḥ parihāraḥ|
tasmāt vidhānārthi iti|
guṇasya tu vidhānārthaṃ tadguṇāḥ prayoge syuranarthakāḥ, nahi taṃ pratyarthavattā'sti|
bhāṣyam-- naitadasti guṇavidhayaḥ iti|
guṇasya vidhānārthā ete santaḥ puroḍāśasya kapāleṣu saṃkhyāṃ vidadhuḥ|
na śaknuvanti yāgaprayogasya vidhātum|
dvādaśakapālatā hi yāgasya vākyena, aṣṭakapāladādyaḥ prakaraṇena|
tena te yāge na bhaviṣyanti|
apica aṣṭakatvādyaḥ puroḍāśaṃ ekavākyabhūtāḥ prakaraṇaṃ bādhitvā na yāgasya bhaviṣyanti|
yāgasaṃbandhe ca anarthakāḥ, puroḍāśasaṃbandhe phalābhāvāt|
arthavādatvena tu vaiśvānara- yāgasya stutirupāpadyate|
tasmāt arthavādā iti|
vā-- 'prakṛtāprakṛte yāge tathā dravye'pi vā guṇaḥ|
dravyaṃ guṇavadevaṃ ca na kathañcid vidhīyate||
' prakṛte tāvat dvādaśatvārohaṇāt nāṣṭakavādayo vidhīyante, na ca dūrasthe tadupādānaśabdābhāvāt|
na ca karmāntaraṃ kevalatvādiguṇakaḥ sambhavati, dravyadevatāsaṃyogapratyakṣayāgā-
śravaṇāt|
etena puroḍāśo saṃkhyāvidhiḥ nedhā'pi pratyuktaḥ ( prakṛtayāgasaṃbandhini, dūrasthayāgasaṃbandhini, apūrvayāga- saṃbandhini vā guṇavidhiḥ iti nedhā'pi pratyuktaḥ) |
tathā aṣṭakapālādipuroḍāśavidhānam ( nedhā'pi pratyuktam|
tatra prakṛte yāge asaṃbandhamāha-) nahi dvādaśakapālapuroḍā- śāvacchedya yāgaḥ puroḍāśāntaraṃ gṛhṇāti|
( dūrasthe asaṃba- ndhamāha-) nāpi anūdite karmaṇi svaśabdena aprakṛte puroḍāśavidhānaṃ phalatsādhanāsaṃyandhaṃ kacidupayujyate|
nāpi anyāpārātmakatvāt dravyaṃ vidhātuṃ śakyate|
ata eva viśvajidādivadapi nādyahāreṇa phalaṃ kalpyate|
( apūrve yāge vidhisaṃbhavamāha-) 'vaiśvānarapadaṃ nāpi yāgāyātrānudyate|
vibhaktyantarayogitvāt na caitada ( ca śrute ) syādanarthakam ||
' ( padottaratvena ślokaṃ vyācaṣṭe-) syādetat|
vaiśvānarapadāttu aṣṭaka- kapālādidravyadevatāsaṃyandhavidheḥ|
yāgāntarasiddhiriti, tannāsti|
prathamā'nteṣu dvitīyā'ntānuṣaṅgāt|
na ca vibhaktivipariṇāmaḥ, anyāsā'pi upapadyamānatvāt|
yadi hi anuṣaṅgavipariṇāmau antareṇa aṣṭakatvavidhānamanarthakaṃ syāt, tat kiṃ vā na kriyata, tat stutyarthatvena upapannatvarāt nārthakam|
tadā ca anuvādāt vipariṇatavibhaktisaṃjñe'pi adoṣaḥ|
( nedhā'pi puroḍāśavidhānaṃ na saṃbhavatītyupasaṃharati-) tasmāt na puroḍāśavidhānam|
na ca dvādaśakapāle aṣṭakapāladayaḥ puroḍāśāḥ svātmabhirvibhaktā vidyante, aṣṭakadimātra- viśeṣadarśanāt|
te ca aṣṭakatvādayaḥ na yāge, nāpi puroḍāśe vidhīyante ityuktam|
na ca aṣṭakavādīnāṃ dvādaśakapālena ekavākyatayā tava ( na ca ityādibhiruktaḥ ) upapadyate, nānāvidheya- ( nānāvidha- ) prayojanavaśeṇa arthakalā- bhāvāt|
na ca nānāvidhānāṃ vibhajyamānānāṃ sākā- ṅkṣatvaṃ vidyate|
yadi ca ekaṃ vākyaṃ bhavet, tataḥ sarva- viśiṣṭaikabhāvanāvidhānāt na vikalpaḥ syāt|
aṣṭakavā- dīnāṃ ca guṇatvāt na pratyekaṃ vākyaparisamāptyā pṛthagnu- ṣṭhānopapattiḥ|
na ca saṃkhyānāṃ sambhavati, saṃkhyā- ntaropajananena sarvābhāvaprasaṅgāt|
saṃkhyāntarānupajana- samuccayastu dvādaśatve aṣṭakatvāntarabhāvāt|
tathābhūtānāṃ ca

iti pūrvaḥ pakṣaḥ |

yathākāmī bhavet iti tu bhāṣye paṭhitam |
apivā'nyāni pātrāṇi sādhāraṇāni kurvīran vipratiṣedhācchāstrakṛtatvāt |
pūrvapakṣaṃ sūtreṇa prāptam apivā itiśabdena viparyastaṃ siddhāntamāha |

anyatamasya pātrāṇāṃ grahaṇe tu vipratiṣedhaḥ syāt |
yasya pātrāṇi gṛhītāni syuḥ, tasya satramadhye daivānmaraṇe tena saha tāni pātrāṇi daheran |
tathā sati satraprayogalopaḥ syāt |
pātrāṇāmadāhe tu mṛtasya dāho viguṇaḥ syāt iti vipratiṣedhaḥ |
sādhāraṇāni ca pātrāṇi śāstrakṛtāni śāstratātparyaviṣayāṇi |
na ca jīvataḥ anyasya pātraiḥ kratunivṛttirastu iti vācyam |
tathāpi prayogaprāśubhāvasya śāstrakṛtatvāt kratuvaiguṇyamavarjanīyameva syāt |

iti siddhāntaḥ |

3|2|17|40-41. # jyotiṣṭome aiṣṭiko nirvāpaḥ prokṣaṇādi ca prātaranuvākottaraṃ kartavyaṃ paścācca saumikāḥ pracaraṇīhomādayaḥ kartavyāḥ |
vi. 5|1| 13, # jyotiṣṭome aiṣṭiko nirvāpaḥ saumikahavirdhāna- śa Hkaṭābhyāṃ bhinne śakaṭe kartavyaḥ |
na tu havirdhāna- śa Hkaṭayoranyatarasmin |
jyotiṣṭome aiṣṭikā: prokṣaṇādayaḥ pūrvamanu- ṣṭheyāḥ pracaraṇīhomādayaḥ saumikāstu paścāt |
pravṛttyā kṛtakālānāma |
bhāṣyam-- jyotiṣṭome śrūyate prātaranuvākāle, 'pratiprasthātaḥ savanīyāhaviṣpaca iti preṣyati' iti savanīyānāṃ nirvāpakālaḥ |
asti ca bahiṣpavamāne stute 'amīdagnīn vihara, barhirlunīhi, puroḍāśānalaṃkuru' iti |
tatra saṃdehaḥ kiṃ prātaranuvākāle savanīyāgniṣya pracaraṇīhomādayaḥ saumikāḥ, uta pauroḍāśikāḥ prāgalaṃkuraṇāditi |
kiṃ prāptam ? aniyamaḥ, niyama- kāriṇaḥ śāstrasyābhāvāditi |
evaṃ prāpte, brūmaḥ |
pravṛttyā kṛtakālānāma |
jñātakālānāṃ padārthānāṃ pravṛttyā niyamaḥ syāt |
prayujyamānameva hi pūrvapadārthamabhinicchati ! sa tasya parastāt samāmnātaḥ parastāt kartavyaḥ |
saumikasya tu padārthasya pracaraṇīhomasya vacanāt kramo bādhitaḥ |
alaṃkaraṇaṃ ca bahiṣpavamānasya parastāt samāmnātam |
tasāttasya pūrvaḥ padārtho nirvāpaṇādīnāmat, tata uccare saumikāḥ padārthāḥ kartavyā iti |
ṭupa-- (adhvaryuṇā 'prātaryāvamyo devebhyo'nubrūhi' iti hotṛ) prātaranuvākameva pradāya anantaraṃ 'pratiprasthātaḥ savanīyān nirvapasva' iti preṣya (pratiprasthātre) dattaḥ |
bahiṣpavamāne stute 'agnīdagnīn vihara' iti (agnīdhe) punaḥ preṣaḥ |
tatra preṣaścodito hotā prātaranuvāke pravṛttaḥ |
adhvaryuḥ upāsyām (hotṛsamīpasthito) vyāpṛtaḥ vacanāt ā prātaranuvākaparisamāpteḥ |
(tena hi manasā prātaranuvākaṃ pratipannatā hotṛḥ samīpe āsitavyam |
